holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 0 shares of MPSLTD as of 23 November 2026 (net worth ₹42,64,305; cash ₹14,20,950 or 33.3%). Nothing is sold. Pass 1's Compounder Pass is provisional. Debt-free cash (₹163.23 Cr), 35%–39% ROCE, and a 48.17% Q2 Research margin remain clear strengths. CARO lists ₹36.3 Cr of unreconciled tax disputes, and ADI BPO carries a diligence disclaimer. We cut new capital to REJECTED (TIER_0, 0% weight). Shares broke into Stage 4 on 25 November at ₹2,054.80 (−2.41% on 1.47x volume; 23 Nov ledger ₹2,105.60). That move broke the 200-day SMA (₹2,084.67) and pivot S1 (₹2,065.93). Base weighted value is ₹2,231 (+6.0% ledger / +8.6% live TV; ₹2,117 strict Basis A) versus ₹1,593 Bear and ₹1,336 Severe-Bear.

primer: MPS builds journals, courses, and training with ₹163.23 Cr cash, zero debt, and 35%–39% ROCE. Still, Pass 1's Compounder Pass is provisional due to −37% FY26 tangible net worth (₹102.2 Cr), 52.5% goodwill/intangibles, 0% yield, and CARO/ADI BPO tax gaps. We cut new capital to REJECTED (TIER_0, 0% weight; NOT_HELD) on a 25 November Stage 4 break at ₹2,054.80 (ledger ₹2,105.60). Pass 1 also flagged −9.9% organic Education sales, OpenEvidence at Johns Hopkins, and +20.4% Research hiring, cutting M&A-adjusted IRR to 11.6%–11.7%. Weighted value is ₹2,231 (₹2,154 under ₹1,336 Severe-Bear stress), ₹1,810–₹1,920 stays monitor-only, and 100% stays in cash.

ch4.stage_override: Stage 4 (25 Nov live TV breakdown at ₹2,054.80; Stage 3 on 23 Nov NSE ledger at ₹2,105.60)
ch4.stage_explanation: On the verified 23 November NSE ledger (₹2,105.60), MPSLTD clung 1.14% above its 200-day SMA (₹2,081.77) after 9 distribution days in 25 sessions. Two sessions later, on 25 November live TradingView (₹2,054.80, −2.41% on 23,442 shares or 1.47x 30D volume), price broke beneath the 200-day SMA (₹2,084.67) and monthly pivot S1 (₹2,065.93), sitting −10.39% below the 30-week SMA (₹2,292.98), −11.05% below the 10-week EMA (₹2,309.98), and −15.37% below the falling 50-day SMA (₹2,427.95). Confirmed Stage 4 breakdown.
ch4.evaluation_stage_explanation: Confirmed Stage 4 breakdown on the 25 November live print (₹2,054.80), with every weekly and daily moving average overhead and 4H reversal false (4H RSI 27.17; daily RSI 29.66).
ch4.intro_prose: We evaluate MPSLTD across both the verified 23 November 2026 NSE ledger close (₹2,105.60) and the 25 November 2026 live TradingView breakdown (₹2,054.80), reconciling automated scanner outputs that sit overhead as broken supply.
ch4.gate_intro_prose: The timing gate asks whether MPSLTD sits in an actionable Stage 2 base near support. On 25 November it fails every gate: price sits 10.4% below its 30-week average, 15.4% below a falling 50-day average, and 1.4% below a broken 200-day average on expanding volume.
ch4.closing_prose: Technical structure confirms our fundamental caution. With the 200-day average broken on 1.47x volume and zero four-hour reversal, we reject new capital completely and keep passive reference markers strictly monitor-only until a Stage 1 base and high-volume Stage 2 reclaim above ₹2,293 appear.
ch4.tech_table_takeaway: Dual-feed SMA reconciliation: Row 4 prints 23 Nov NSE ledger daily SMAs (₹2,262.23 / ₹2,450.65 / ₹2,081.77, where ledger close ₹2,105.60 sat −14.08% below 50D SMA and +1.14% above 200D SMA; Stage 3, 9 distribution days, −32.44% 63D RS vs Nifty 50) alongside the 25 Nov live TradingView 50D extension (−15.37%, calculated from ₹2,054.80 vs TV daily SMAs ₹2,252.32 / ₹2,427.95 / ₹2,084.67; −10.39% vs 30W SMA ₹2,292.98 and −1.43% below broken 200D SMA on 1.47x 30D volume). The stricter Stage 4 live tape governs timing.
ch4.posture_explanation: TradingView's stage gate is CAP_REJECTED (AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN). Breaking the 200-day average and pivot S1 on expanding volume prohibits dip-buying.
ch4.support_zone_explanation: Passive Stage 4 monitor-only reference shelf (NOT a buy zone) anchored on monthly pivot S2 (₹1,810.97) and 14x–15x forward earnings. Explicitly overrides TradingView's raw broken overhead band (₹2,275.33–₹2,464.37), which sits 11%–20% above the live ₹2,054.80 close.
ch4.stop_placement_explanation: Passive monitor-only reference floor strictly below pivot S2 (₹1,810.97) and below CMP (NOT an active stop or order). Explicitly overrides TradingView's raw overhead invalidation level (₹2,244.41), which sits above live price.
